name: Command Re-roll
description: When any phase, just after you make an Advance roll, a Charge roll, a Desperate Escape test or a Hazardous test for a unit from your army, or a Hit roll, a Wound roll, a Damage roll or a saving throw for a model in that unit, or a roll to determine the number of attacks made with a weapon equipped by a model in that unit, you can re-roll that roll, test or saving throw.

name: Counter-offensive
description: When the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has fought, target one unit from your army within Engagement Range of enemies that has not already been selected to fight this phase. Your unit fights next.

name: Epic Challenge
description: When the Fight phase, when a Character unit from your army within Engagement Range of one or more Attached units is selected to fight, one Character model in that unit gains [PRECISION] on all its melee attacks until the end of the phase.

name: Insane Bravery
description: When the Battle-shock step of your Command phase, just before you take a Battle-shock test for a unit from your army, that unit automatically passes that test. You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.

name: Grenade
description: When your Shooting phase, one Grenades unit from your army (excluding units that Advanced, Fell Back or have shot this turn) that is not within Engagement Range of enemies can select one Grenades model and one enemy unit not within Engagement Range of your units, within 8" of and visible to that model. Roll six D6: each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound.

name: Tank Shock
description: When your Charge phase, just after a Vehicle unit from your army ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and one Vehicle model in your unit within Engagement Range of that enemy unit. Roll a number of D6 equal to that model's Toughness: each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (maximum 6).

name: Rapid Ingress
description: When the end of your opponent's Movement phase, one unit from your army in Reserves can arrive on the battlefield as if it were the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase. If every model in that unit has Deep Strike, it can be set up using Deep Strike. It cannot arrive in a battle round in which it would not normally be able to do so.

name: Fire Overwatch
description: When your opponent's Movement or Charge phase, just after an enemy unit is set up, starts or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, or declares a charge, one unit from your army within 24" of it that would be eligible to shoot can shoot that enemy unit if it is visible. Hits only on unmodified 6s; once per turn; cannot target Titanic units.

name: Go to Ground
description: When your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, one Infantry unit from your army selected as a target gains a 6+ invulnerable save and the Benefit of Cover until the end of the phase.

name: Smokescreen
description: When your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets, one Smoke unit from your army selected as a target gains the Benefit of Cover and the Stealth ability until the end of the phase.

name: Heroic Intervention
description: When your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move, one unit from your army within 6" of it that could declare a charge against it does so, targeting only that enemy unit. Vehicles can only do so if they are Walkers; the unit does not receive a Charge bonus this turn.
